key_findings.depset_equality: Depset == is NestedSet identity in Bazel 9.3 (depset([1]) == depset([1]) is False; empty depsets of an order are equal), so structs holding separately created depsets are not deduplicated (run 1 MISMATCH; fixed).
key_findings.traversal: each NestedSet node keeps its own order layout; a default/preorder node inside a topological depset is not reversed (run 1 r_topo MISMATCH; native flatten fixed; orders=/deep= probes equal in run 2).
key_findings.struct_dedup: struct() values and provider instances with equal fields (same provider) deduplicate across direct, transitive and targets; struct() never equals a provider instance; both share the element type struct.
key_findings.gaps: Bazel accepts frozen lists and lambdas inside depset elements (outputs recorded in G/*); native fails explicitly.
